crossRefs.note: Why have you despised Yahweh’s word, to do that which is evil in his sight? You have struck Uriah the Hittite with the…
Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Heth
people.line: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: The men of the city went out, and fought with Joab. Some of the people fell, even of David’s servants; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
translations.bsb: And when the men of the city came out and fought against Joab, some of David’s servants fell, and Uriah the Hittite also died.
translations.kjv: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
translations.asv: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people, even of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
